title: Reconstructing double-well potentials from transition layers in long-range phase coexistence models
summary: In models of phase coexistence, the precise form of the double-well potential is of central importance, yet it cannot be derived from first principles. In this paper, we investigate an inverse problem: starting from a prescribed transition layer with power-type decay at infinity, we reconstruct the structural properties of the associated double-well potential. We focus on the case of long-range interactions, where the dependence of the potential on the layer and its derivatives is particularly delicate.
